sites.name: ATK Dinh Hoa Historical Relic Area
sites.event: Known as the 'Capital of the Wind and Forest', the leadership center of the resistance war against the French colonialists (1946-1954) of the Party Central Committee and Uncle Ho.

sites.name: Nui Coc Lake
sites.event: A famous scenic spot associated with the tragic love legend of Lady Cong and Lord Coc.

sites.name: Museum of the Cultures of Vietnam's Ethnic Groups
sites.event: A place that preserves, conserves, and displays more than 40,000 documents and artifacts on the culture of the 54 brotherly ethnic groups (one of the 5 national museums).

sites.name: Tan Cuong Tea Hills
sites.event: The most famous tea region in Vietnam, known as the 'First-class Tea' with premium hook-shaped tea products.

sites.name: Duom Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for Duong Tu Minh (Saint Duom), the talented leader of Phu Luong Prefecture and a royal son-in-law under two reigns of the Ly Dynasty.

sites.name: Phuong Hoang Cave - Mo Ga Stream
sites.event: A national scenic relic, a majestic limestone cave located on Phuong Hoang Mountain with a stream flowing from the heart of the mountain.

sites.name: Company 915 Volunteer Youth Historical Relic Area
sites.event: The memorial site for 60 volunteer youths who heroically sacrificed their lives in the US B-52 bombing raid on Christmas Eve in 1972.

sites.name: Cua Tu Stream
sites.event: A famous adventure trekking destination with a pristine stream flowing through vertical cliffs.

sites.name: Ghenh Che Lake
sites.event: A large ecological lake, an emerging camping and ecotourism destination.

sites.name: Hang Pagoda (Kim Son Pagoda)
sites.event: An ancient pagoda located inside 3 large rocky mountains (Huyen Vu, Thanh Long, Bach Ho), likened to a 'Fairyland'.

sites.name: Ly Nam De Historical Relic Area (Huong Ap Pagoda)
sites.event: The hometown and place of worship of King Ly Nam De (Ly Bi), the first emperor of Vietnam (Van Xuan state).

sites.name: Mua Roi Waterfall (Nam Rut Waterfall)
sites.event: A beautiful waterfall cascading from a limestone cliff into the Than Sa River, creating a mist of water like falling rain.
